lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na2Mg(FeO2)4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 19 atoms and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Fe in a tetrahedral O environment (four neighbors per Fe, 1.89–1.95 Å), while Mg shows a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement of O and Na; Na centers have 11 geometric neighbors. The Fe tetrahedra share corners with one another and share faces with the 12-vertex Mg and Na coordination polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
